summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Jonas Valančiūnas, a Lithuanian professional basketball player. It states his birth date and current team, the Memphis Grizzlies of the NBA, and notes that the Toronto Raptors drafted him fifth overall in 2011.
one_line: Lithuanian professional basketball player for the Memphis Grizzlies, drafted fifth overall by the Toronto Raptors in 2011.
key_facts: Jonas Valančiūnas is a Lithuanian professional basketball player.
Jonas Valančiūnas was born on 6 May 1992.
Jonas Valančiūnas plays for the Memphis Grizzlies of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
Jonas Valančiūnas was selected by the Toronto Raptors with the fifth overall pick in the 2011 NBA draft.
